# Known blockers do not make an otherwise fully evaluated project partial.
exec ctx orient --bundle bundle --detail
! stderr .
stdout 'Evaluation: complete; inventory: complete'
stdout 'Shortlist:'
stdout 'Pick next \[next\]'
stdout 'readiness: ready'
stdout 'readiness: blocked'
stdout 'eligible: true'
stdout 'Backlog:'
stdout 'Later work \[later\]'

exec ctx orient --bundle bundle --json
! stderr .
cp stdout report.json
jsonorientation report.json true
stdout '"shortlist":\[\{[^}]*"id":"next"[^}]*\}\]'
stdout '"backlog":\[\{[^}]*"id":"later"[^}]*\}\]'
stdout '"readiness":"blocked"'

# Required context that disappears makes the report partial and removes eligibility.
rm bundle/context.md
exit 1 ctx orient --bundle bundle --json
! stderr .
cp stdout partial.json
jsonorientation partial.json false
stdout '"shortlist":\[\]'
stdout 'source_missing'

-- bundle/project.md --
---
type: Project
id: project
title: Readiness project
---
## Goals
Make deliberate progress.
## Current commitments
- [Empty criteria](blocked.md)
- [Pick next](next.md)
## Open decisions
None
